card.law_is_about: Income-tax changes including raising the employee expense allowance from EUR 1,230 to EUR 1,430.
card.they_want: Give priority to a workday allowance instead of merely raising the existing employee allowance.
card.they_claim: Every compulsory-assessment case requires the employment-income attachment regardless of expenses.
card.the_problem: Official instructions permit omission of that attachment when electronic wage data suffice and specified extra entries are unnecessary. A compulsory return alone does not remove that exception.

locator.section: Anlage N: Einkünfte aus nichtselbständiger Arbeit, introductory exception and its three cumulative bullet conditions

correction: The official 2025 instructions for unrestricted taxpayers dispense with Anlage N where wage data were transmitted electronically, no entries are needed in lines 10, 18–19 or 21–26, and employment expenses do not exceed the applicable allowance. Those conditions can coexist with compulsory assessment, for example ordinary electronic wage data for spouses using III/V. The requirement to submit a tax return is distinct from the requirement to complete this attachment.
effect: This weakens the categorical procedural objection to the allowance increase as a simplification. It does not validate the government estimate that 1.3 million taxpayers will omit the attachment, nor settle the comparison with a workday allowance.
limits: Some compulsory-assessment cases do require extra entries and an attachment; the finding concerns the universal assertion, not every example. Higher expenses after a move or job change can still require entries. Existing 2025 guidance is not a complete specification of future 2027 forms. No claim about actual filing behaviour, total time saved, distributional fairness or the preferred allowance is established.
context_and_alternatives: All thirteen author pages were read, including both the qualified opening criticism and the later workday-allowance request. The original expressly says all compulsory-assessment cases, gives III/V and factor combinations as examples, and says the attachment must be submitted regardless of expenses.

A strong benign reading is practical shorthand: tax software may prefill or transmit employment data and advisers still check whether expenses exceed the allowance. That practical work is real, but does not make the stated universal attachment obligation accurate.

The preceding sentence merely says the government estimate cannot be confirmed so generally. That qualified challenge and the distinct possibility of changing personal circumstances remain defensible; neither is treated as a proven error.

The exact bill changes section 9a and its memorandum physical pages 26 and 28 explicitly estimates omitted attachments. No amendment abolishing the electronic-data exception is identified in the operative text relevant to the claim.

The official unrestricted-taxpayer ELSTER page was checked directly. An initially discovered restricted-taxpayer help page was not substituted as the counter-source. The published guidance for tax year 2025 is retrieved live on October 25; no frozen October 21 webpage snapshot is claimed.

An official tax-office leaflet with a July 2020 footer separately confirms that entire attachments N, R and Vorsorgeaufwand may be omitted where electronically supplied data suffice and no other entries are needed. It explicitly retains the main return in every case. This is supplementary historical artifact evidence, not proof of a frozen October 21 webpage.
materiality_explanation: Minor: one concrete procedural premise overstates the remaining filing burden. The overall reform request also rests on separate simplicity and fairness arguments, and the numerical government forecast is not independently tested.
direction_explanation: True narrowly: overstating an unavoidable attachment requirement supports preferring the proposed alternative allowance by understating the existing bill’s possible simplification. This is separate from materiality and does not show the alternative policy is worse.

confidence.text_source_mismatch: high for the universal attachment assertion against the express official exception
